>
[Accompanist](/Familiars.aspx?ID=108) <actions string="" />
</title>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 212

**Ability Type** Familiar

</column>

Your familiar helps you perform. Whenever you attempt a [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) check, if your familiar is nearby and can act, it accompanies you with chirps, claps, or its own miniature instrument. This grants you a +1 circumstance bonus, or +2 if you're a master in Performance.
name: Accompanist
